messages:
lee: observed a surge of SCIM PATCH failures this morning from our Okta connector, customers reporting missing group memberships after a routine RBAC tightening. Noticed around 07:40 UTC.

sara: can you paste an example error? is it 403/400/422?

lee: gist of the provisioner log:
```
2026-03-24T07:40:12Z ERROR scim-connector patch failed status=422 body=\"invalid assertion: audience mismatch\" trace=tx-77f
2026-03-24T07:40:13Z INFO token-introspect client=svc-scim-02 aud=[https://api.redwood.internal] scopes=[scim:write scim:read]
```

max: interesting. we rotated the SAML/JWK signing set at 07:35 for rotation window. if SAML assertions reference old kid it could trigger audience/issuer validation failures on our side.

lee: But introspect shows aud correct. The upstream IdP complains about malformed subject when we call their group-sync endpoint. Okta returns 400 with body:
```
{"error":"invalid_request","error_description":"subject nameid missing"}
```

sara: Did the RBAC change affect the service account's principal mapping or role attributes that we inject into assertions? The prune job added a cleanup rule to strip deprecated role claims from system accounts.

max: We did add a filter in the role-mapper at 07:36 to remove legacy "platform_admin" claim from non-human principals. If the IdP expects that nameid/role to construct Okta provisioning subject it could break.

lee: Also seeing intermittent KMS unwrap failures earlier around 07:38: 
```
2026-03-24T07:38:01Z WARN kms unwrap failed key=service-tokens err=\"key disabled\"
2026-03-24T07:38:02Z WARN kms unwrap failed key=service-tokens err=\"invalid envelope\"
```

zack: That matches a brief scheduled rewrap we ran at 07:37 to move tokens to a freshly created key version. The controller accidentally set new key state=disabled for ~90s while verifying.

sara: So chain: jwk rotate -> role-mapper started stripping legacy claim -> KMS rewrap briefly disabled old key -> result: assertions missing expected nameid/claim and some tokens failed unwrap -> Okta rejects SCIM group changes.

max: remediation proposals: 1) revert role-mapper filter so system principals still emit nameid until we coordinate with IdP. 2) re-enable old key permanently or ensure key transitions do not disable old versions. 3) pause any RBAC automated prune until we have invariant checks.

lee: Agree. I'll roll back the mapper change and redeploy. Running:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/role-mapper --to-revision=42
```
ETA 1m.

ops-bot: deployment role-mapper rolled back to revision 42 by lee.

zack: I'm re-running KMS rewrap but with warm-forward: keep previous key enabled for 24h then schedule disable. Starting now.

sara: We should also publish a one-line preflight in the prune job that verifies all system service-accounts retain at least one scim role claim and that token introspect returns scim:write. Add it as a gate.

max: I'll open a quick unit/integration test in CI to call IdP SCIM staging and validate that subject + groups are accepted after any claim change. Also add a smoke that introspects svc-scim-02 token post-rotation.

lee: Customer communication draft: "We identified a transient provisioning disruption affecting group membership changes after a set of coordinated maintenance tasks (signing key rotation, token rewrap, and RBAC rule update). We have rolled back the RBAC filter and re-run provisioning reconciliation; we expect membership restoration within 1-2 hours for affected tenants." Thoughts?

sara: lgtm, call out that no user plaintext credentials were exposed and only group assignments were affected. Add link to incident INC-20260324-73.

zack: full logs uploaded to secure blob: https://internal.redwood/logs/2026-03-24/scim-77f (access: eng-security)

lee: I'll mute the scim-syncer queue to avoid further dangerous PATCHes during recon. @ops-bot mute scim-syncer 60m

ops-bot: scim-syncer muted by lee for 60 minutes.

max: follow-ups: 1) add a rollback guard to role-mapper; 2) implement KMS warm-forward policy; 3) add pre-checks to prune workflow; 4) run an end-to-end smoke after any key/JWK/role mapping change.

sara: I'll own the PR for prune pre-checks. Lee please add your rollback notes to the incident timeline.

lee: will do. creating incident now.
